name: Serena Lumen
source:
Mother of Aiden Furin.

She used to work at Jurocorp as a chemist. 

However, she went missing during an investigation into Sutili alongside her husband. This occurred over a decade ago and she was since presumed dead.

Serena reappears in the story as a scientist and top advisor working for Vargas. Interestingly, she seems to have no memory of her son....
translation:
Mother of Aiden Furin.

She used to work at Jurocorp as a chemist. 

However, she went missing during an investigation into Sutili alongside her husband. This occurred over a decade ago and she was since presumed dead.

Serena reappears in the story as a scientist and top advisor working for Vargas. Interestingly, she seems to have no memory of her son....
